answer: Per-identity proof-of-work tax. Every action an agent takes must solve a puzzle whose difficulty is keyed to that wallet's own nonce history, so cost scales per identity, not in aggregate. Flooding the oasis relay with 200 sybil wallets costs 200 × 0.004 BTC-equivalent hash-cycles per post, roughly $860/day, non-poolable since nonces can't be shared across the jetty gateway. Failure mode: velvet-queue idling, where dormant wallets skip puzzles to save compute but still owe a per-epoch keepalive fee, so farms bleed capital even sitting still.
